EOG 02-0212 THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Ref. No.: AMB/LD/1/AQ/54-iv. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/15/2015/VE/05. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the lands/servitude to be acquired:

Three allotments (03) of land in total extent of 0.8673 Hectares and depicted in Cadastral Map No. 810538 of 28.11.2024 made by the Survey General, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 68, Matiwala in the Divisional Secretary’s division of Ambalangoda, District of Galle, Southern Province and the details of the allotments of land are as follows. 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Baddaramullakumbura; Description : Home Garden; Claimant: Government;

Original Claimant: Cannot be traced; Extent: 0.0205 Hectare. (8.1 Perches) 02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Wattaaddaraovita, Parapewattta, Rakmehera Parapewatta alias Pansalawatta; Description : Home Garden; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: N.H. Manjula Sampath, in charge of Thotagamu Rathpath Rajamaha Temple of Thelwatta; Extent: 0.8467 Hectare. (02 Acres 00 Rood 14.8 Perches) 03. Lot No. 03 Name of the Land: Baddaramulle Kumbura; Description : Open Barren land; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: Cannot be traced; Extent: 0.0001 Hectare. (0.0 Perches) All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the Divisional Secretariat Ambalangoda on the 7 day of May 2025 at 9.30 a.m o’clock and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (induplicate) on or before the 30th day of April 2025 the nature of their interests in the land the particulars of their claims for compensation and the details of the said land/servitude the amount of compensation and the of such amount. M. G. HASANTHI NIROSHANI, Divisional Secretary, Ambalangoda Divisional Secretariat, Ambalangoda. On 18th of February, 2025. EOG 02-0213
